title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Fabricating False Terrorist Information Crime
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Fabricating False Terrorist Information

Case 1:

Zhang Wanqi — Fabricating False Terrorist Information

(1) Brief Facts

At approximately 7:00 p.m. on March 23, 2007, the defendant Zhang Wanqi, due to a financial dispute with her ex-boyfriend Gong, went to the song and dance hall contracted by Gong at Peking University's Second Gymnasium to collect the day's business proceeds. After being refused, Zhang Wanqi used her mobile phone to call "110" and falsely reported that there was a bomb inside Peking University's Second Gymnasium. This caused the public security authority to dispatch multiple police officers to the scene for search and inspection, and to evacuate over 200 people from inside Peking University's Second Gymnasium.

(2) Judgment

The judgment of first instance by the Haidian District People's Court of Beijing and the ruling of second instance by the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People's Court held that: The defendant Zhang Wanqi, disregarding national law, fabricated terrorist information such as an explosion, seriously disrupting social order. Her conduct constituted the crime of fabricating false terrorist information. Given that Zhang Wanqi was a person with limited criminal responsibility and had a good attitude towards confession, a lighter punishment could be imposed according to law. The defendant Zhang Wanqi was sentenced to two years' imprisonment.

Case 2:

Pan Jun — Fabricating False Terrorist Information

(1) Brief Facts

At approximately 1:30 p.m. on November 30, 2010, the defendant Pan Jun, on Chisha Nanyue Street, Haizhu District, Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province, used his mobile phone to call the "110" emergency number. He fabricated false terrorist information claiming that a bomb had been installed inside the Guanzhou Police Station of the Haizhu Branch of the Guangzhou Public Security Bureau and would explode in 15 minutes. This caused the public security authority to dispatch a large number of police officers to search and inspect the Guanzhou Police Station and its surroundings.

(2) Judgment

The judgment of first instance by the Haizhu District People's Court of Guangzhou, Guangdong Province and the ruling of second instance by the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court held that: The defendant Pan Jun fabricated false terrorist information threatening an explosion, seriously disrupting social order. His conduct constituted the crime of fabricating false terrorist information. The defendant Pan Jun was sentenced to one year and three months' imprisonment.

Case 3:

Xiong Yi — Fabricating False Terrorist Information

(1) Brief Facts

At approximately 10:00 p.m. on August 30, 2012, the defendant Xiong Yi learned that his creditor would be taking a flight to collect a debt from him. In order to prevent or delay the creditor's arrival, he called the Shenzhen Airport customer service complaint hotline and falsely claimed that there was an explosive device on Shenzhen Airlines Flight ZH9706 from Xiangyang to Shenzhen that day, which would explode 45 minutes after takeoff. After receiving the report, Shenzhen Airlines immediately activated a Level 1 response procedure, coordinating with air traffic control to direct Flight ZH9706 to make an emergency diversion to Tianhe Airport in Wuhan. During the emergency diversion, nine airborne flights were required to make emergency avoidance maneuvers. All ground-standby flights at Wuhan Tianhe Airport were halted, and a Level 2 emergency response procedure was activated. More than 200 personnel from firefighting, armed police, and other departments were mobilized for on-site emergency response. To transport passengers stranded at the airport, Shenzhen Airlines temporarily added two additional flights. This caused Shenzhen Airlines direct economic losses of over RMB 170,000.

(2) Judgment

The Xiangyang High-tech Industrial Development Zone People's Court of Hubei Province held after trial that: The defendant Xiong Yi intentionally fabricated false terrorist information, seriously disrupting social order. His conduct constituted the crime of fabricating false terrorist information. The defendant Xiong Yi was sentenced to four years' imprisonment. After the judgment was pronounced, the defendant Xiong Yi did not appeal, and the judgment has taken legal effect.
